correctness.rationale: Exact row/column joint factorial moments (a)_r (b)_s exp[-rb u -sa v +rs min(u,v)] from intersecting selected rows/columns; Poisson factorial-moment criterion gives independent limits and Gumbel clocks. A terminal shared edge unique a.s. has density ab exp[-(a+b-1)t] F_{a-1,b-1}(t) from remaining independent residual matrix; inclusion-exclusion integration proves finite rational double sum. Scaling t=(log n+x)/n yields density e^{-2x-2cosh(kappa/2)e^{-x}} and integrable tail bounds via no-isolate residual bound. Integration yields 1/lambda² and conditional Gamma(2,1). Independent exhaustive exponential-clock ordering enumeration for 2x2,2x3,2x4,3x3 and two-time state tests agrees exactly.
